ng-add.description: Add the workspace overlay and dependency policy to an existing Angular workspace.

workspace.description: Root-level overlay: tsconfig paths, Playwright base, house rules, docs.

app.description: A client-rendered application, optionally with a Capacitor mobile sibling.

marketing.description: A statically prerendered marketing site. No Node server.

ui-lib.description: A design-system library: ng-packagr, Storybook, Vitest browser mode, SCSS layering and a contrast checker.

mobile.description: A Capacitor sibling for an existing application.

codegen.description: OpenAPI client generation with orval, wired into the pre* hooks.

packages.description: Curated extra packages — the Angular CDK and friends — at a version resolved against the Angular line.
